title: INNER JOIN
description: Return matching rows from two tables.

data.text: INNER JOIN returns rows when there is a match in both tables.

data.title: Inner Join
data.code:
SELECT u.id, u.email, o.id AS order_id, o.total
FROM users u
INNER JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = u.id
WHERE u.deleted_at IS NULL
LIMIT 100;

data.title: Exercise: Match Users to Orders
data.description: Write an inner join between users and orders.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Use INNER JOIN for matching rows.
